
# @hexa-ui/tokens
The **@hexa-ui/tokens** project is responsible for converting design tokens into CSS, SCSS, and JSON formats.

These tokens are defined by the design team and are used to maintain consistency and coherence across the design system.

By automating the conversion process, this project ensures that the design tokens are always up-to-date and easily accessible for use in various projects and applications.

## Stack
- [Style Dictionary
](https://github.com/amzn/style-dictionary)


## Installing

Install @hexa-ui/tokens using yarn, npm or pnpm.

```bash
yarn add @hexa-ui/tokens
```

## Usage

```typescript
import '@hexa-ui/tokens/dist/css/tokens.css'; // css variables
import '@hexa-ui/tokens/dist/scss/tokens.scss'; // scss variables
import tokens from '@hexa-ui/tokens/dist/json/nested.json'; // nested json
import tokens from '@hexa-ui/tokens/dist/json/flat.json'; // flat json
```
